_source: Official embassy/consulate websites for each country

Identity: Valid passport (6+ months validity beyond stay)
One passport-size photo (2x2 inches, white background)
Supporting: Hotel reservations or host invitation letter
Photos: 2 x 2 inch photo (51 x 51 mm), white background, taken within last 6 months

Financial: Bank statements showing sufficient funds (tuition + living expenses)
Sponsor letter and financial documents if someone else is paying
Supporting: I-20 form from the US school

Financial: Evidence of job offer / employment contract
Petitioner's tax returns and W-2 (last 3 years)
Supporting: Police clearance certificates from all countries lived in for 6+ months since age 16

Identity: Valid passport (valid for stay duration + 6 months recommended)
Financial: Proof of income or employment letter
Proof of assets or property ownership
Supporting: Hotel/accommodation reservation or host invitation letter (IMM 5476 if applicable)
Photos: 2 photos: 50mm x 70mm (2 x 2.75 inches), white background

Financial: Proof of tuition payment or scholarship letter
Bank statements or financial guarantee showing sufficient funds ($10,000+ CAD per year)
Supporting: Letter of Acceptance from a Designated Learning Institution (DLI)
Proof of English/French proficiency (IELTS, CELPIP, TEF)

Financial: Employment contract or job offer letter
Supporting: Labour Market Impact Assessment (LMIA) from employer
Educational credentials and work experience documents

Financial: Sponsor's tax returns (NOA - Notice of Assessment)
Sponsor's employment letter and pay stubs
Supporting: Proof of relationship (photos, communication records, visit history)
Police certificates from all countries lived in 6+ months since age 18

Financial: Proof of employment and salary / business ownership
Proof you can afford the trip
Supporting: Proof of ties to home country (job, property, family)
Photos: One passport-size photo (35mm x 45mm, light grey or cream background)
Forms: UK Standard Visitor Visa Application (online via GOV.UK)

Financial: Proof of funds: tuition fees + living costs (£1,334/month London; £1,023/month elsewhere)
Parent or sponsor financial evidence if applicable
Supporting: Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) from UKVI-licensed institution
IELTS/TOEFL scores or equivalent English test
Tuberculosis test results (if from a listed country)
Certificate of Sponsorship (CoS) from UK employer
Criminal record certificate (if required by role)
Evidence of genuine relationship (photos, messages, visit history)

Photos: Recent passport-size photo (if required by the specific visa subclass)

Financial: Proof of funds: tuition + AUD 21,041/year living costs minimum
Supporting: Confirmation of Enrolment (CoE) from Australian institution
Labour Market Testing (LMT) evidence from employer
Forms: Temporary Skill Shortage Visa (subclass 482) via ImmiAccount

Supporting: Evidence of genuine relationship (statutory declaration, photos, joint finances)
Police clearance from all countries resided in for 12+ months in last 10 years

Identity: Valid passport (issued within last 10 years, valid 3 months beyond planned stay)
Financial: Bank statements (last 3 months, minimum €50/day or €500 total)
Credit card statement or sponsorship letter
Supporting: Hotel / accommodation booking or invitation letter
Travel insurance (min €30,000 coverage across all Schengen states)
Forms: Uniform Schengen Visa Application Form (available at embassy/VFS/TLScontact)

Financial: Proof of sufficient funds for study period
Supporting: Proof of accommodation in destination country
Forms: National long-stay (D) visa application form from embassy of primary destination country

Identity: Marriage certificate or proof of relationship
Supporting: Proof of residence of EU/Schengen family member
Forms: National long-stay (D) visa application or EU Family Member residence card application

Financial: Proof of accommodation or hotel booking
Supporting: Hotel booking confirmation or host's UAE residence visa copy
Photos: Recent colour photo with white background
Forms: Online visa application via ICP (Federal Authority for Identity and Citizenship) or authorized agent

Supporting: Medical test (blood test + chest X-ray in UAE)
Forms: Employer-sponsored entry permit + Residence visa application in UAE

Financial: Bank statement or proof of sufficient funds
Photos: One photo: 45mm x 45mm, white background, taken within last 6 months
Forms: Japan Visa Application Form (available from Japanese embassy/consulate)

Financial: Proof of sufficient living and tuition funds
Supporting: Certificate of Eligibility (CoE) from Japanese immigration authorities (obtained by school)
Acceptance letter from Japanese educational institution
Forms: Japan Visa Application Form + Certificate of Eligibility

Financial: Sufficient funds for stay (SGD 500+ minimum recommended)
Supporting: Yellow fever vaccination (if arriving from endemic country)
Photos: Not typically required for visa-exempt visitors; photo required for visa applicants
Forms: SGVIA (Singapore Visitor Visa) for those who require a visa

Identity: NZeTA (NZ Electronic Travel Authority) if visa-waiver eligible
Financial: NZD 1,000/month or NZD 400 + return ticket proof
Supporting: Evidence of ties to home country
Photos: Not required for NZeTA; photo required for visitor visa applicants
Forms: NZeTA via New Zealand Immigration (mobile app or website)

Identity: Valid passport (valid 3 months beyond planned stay)
Photos: 2 recent biometric photos (35mm x 45mm, white/off-white background)
Forms: Schengen Visa Application Form (available from German embassy)

Supporting: German language proficiency (TestDaF, DSH) or English for English-taught programs
Forms: German National Visa (Nationales Visum) application via German embassy
